patch_resolves_note: The fixed HarfBuzz image keeps the original PoC clean by returning early when the ligature action loop reaches component_guard with buffer->idx == buffer->len. Stage 04 could not produce an adjacent fixed-side case where the protected component_sanitize event still executed with buffer->idx < buffer->len, so the root missing-guard criterion remained unverified even though the non-root propagation and sink invariants verified on the vulnerable side.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: Immediately before evaluating buffer->cur().codepoint + offset in the ligature action loop, buffer->idx must be strictly less than buffer->len so the read stays within the initialized live glyph run.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed image inserts if (buffer->idx >= buffer->len) return false; before the component_idx computation, guarding the end-of-text cur() read.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original case violates the predicate with component_guard.idx_before_cur == component_guard.len_before_cur == 19 and still executes component_sanitize. The fixed original and the three closest recorded perturbations never supplied a genuine fixed-side witness where component_sanitize executed with idx < len.

nodes.description: On the crashing ligature path, the move_to() call leaves the buffer cursor at the logical end of the live glyph run, so the next current-glyph read would target the first spare slot.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records move_to_result.idx_after_move == move_to_result.len_after_move == 19.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, check_range receives the same component table reference selected immediately before componentData.sanitize() on the crashing path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records component_sanitize.component_ref_addr == check_range_use.base_ptr at the final componentData -> check_range hop.

edges.description: The same end-of-text cursor index produced by move_to() is the index later consumed at the missing-guard site before buffer->cur().codepoint is read.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records move_to_result.idx_after_move == component_guard.idx_before_cur == 19.

edges.description: The component table reference selected immediately before componentData.sanitize() is the same pointer later consumed as the base argument at the check_range sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records component_sanitize.component_ref_addr == check_range_use.base_ptr at the final hop into check_range.
